'''Carlon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Carlon led the Imperial forces that captured the [[Balmorran resistance]]'s [[Camp Shadow]], and was [[Death/Legends|slain]] in a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] incursion to wipe the outpost's files.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Carlon appears as a named enemy in the mission "Hasty Exit" for Republic players in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
